data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a pre-seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia B.S. Physics and Mechanical Engineering, '20), which has raised $175K to date. The valuation landscape for the sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers operating in climate and energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given Western Chemicals' early stage and nascent operating metrics, peer-median triangulation was not applicable; the sector contains only eight comparable companies, insufficient to isolate a statistically reliable peer set at identical stage and valuation tier. Accordingly, stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation approach. Using the company's $175K in total raised as a base proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from pre-seed to next stage, this method implies a valuation of $438K.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $372K to $503K, centered on $438K, derived from a single applicable method. Material uncertainties include the founder's operating track record (no prior exit or company-building experience cited), technology differentiation relative to the broader Climate & Energy peer set, and capital efficiency trajectory post-seed. Investors should require evidence of technical validation and customer engagement before advancing to later-stage discussions.
